questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Colombia?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Colombia article.

questions.proof: The capital of Colombia is Bogotá.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Colombia?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Colombia on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Colombia article.

questions.proof: The countries that have borders on the continent with Colombia are: Venezuela (east), Brazil (southeast), Peru (south), Ecuador (southwest) and Panama (west).

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Colombia?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Meaning” part of the Colombia article.

questions.proof: The official language is Spanish, but there are many languages spoken by minorities that are official in local jurisdictions.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “In 1550 the Spanish declared the territory as a colony and its capital was Santa Fe de Bogotá, but in the first decades it depended on _____.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “depended”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “The colony” part of the Colombia article.

questions.proof: In 1550 the Spanish declared the territory as a colony and its capital was Santa Fe de Bogotá, but in the first decades it depended on Peru.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “On November 11, 1810, the city of Cartagena de Indias declared its independence from _____.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “independence”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Independence” part of the Colombia article.

questions.proof: On November 11, 1810, the city of Cartagena de Indias declared its independence from Spain.
